title: Align Pay-to Name 2 editability with the other pay-to address fields on purchase documents
summary: Pay-to Name 2 field on purchase documents is now editable under the same conditions as other pay-to address fields when custom address is selected or vendor differs from buy-from vendor.
key_points: Pay-to Name 2 editability aligned with other pay-to address fields on three purchase pages
Field now editable when Custom Address is selected or pay-to vendor differs from buy-from vendor
Previously editable only when Another Vendor option was selected
Identical two-property change applied across all localization layers (APAC, BE, CH, DACH, ES, FI, IT, NA, NL, NO, RU)
Extended test coverage verifies editability alongside sibling address fields
